files.rationale: Kept PR B's released 5.7.1 (dated, with its fixed entries and reworded smart-picker line) and new 5.7.2 threshold-lines section, and merged PR A's grouping fixes, Changed and Added entries into the 5.7.1 section without duplicating the smart-picker entry.

PR B's only change (skip parent-group placement when rendering into the favorites section) is already contained in PR A's rewritten buildNavigationRow, which also adds item-type-qualified group IDs, so PR A's version is used, including its generic drag-and-drop grouping for panoramas and datasets.
